scope: Proposition 8.3 (Terminal observation gap) of the manuscript “A spectral gap throughout the high-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick phase” (preprints/A-spectral-gap-throughout-the-high-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-phase-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 227 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d1eccdc9781a9cf3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 63. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix j ∈ (0, 1). There are finite T > 0, c > 0, and events Eterm n depending only on J, with PJ (Eterm n ) → 1, such that the following holds for every sufficiently large n and every J ∈ Eterm n . Let X have any probability law on {−1, 1}n, possibly depending on J, and let Z be an independent standard Gaussian vector. Set Y = TX + √ T Z. Then, conditionally on J, except on an event of probability at most e−cn, the inequality VarµY (f) ≤ 2DY (f) (8.14) holds simultaneously for every real function f on the cube. All constants and matrix events are independent of the law of X.
